title: My first press
text: My first press. I don't want to copy  Sandy Belshe "SandyB" review, but I pretty much have the same thing to say except this was my first French Press.  I got mine to test drive. I think it's a reasonable price. You must put the water in just a little at a time or it will come out.  My coffee grounds aren't really fine so I don't have much of an issue of the grounds going into coffee.  It does a good job, but I think, I'll stick with my Black & Decker Brew and Go.

product_metadata.title: BonJour Ami-Matin Unbreakable French Press Coffee Maker, for Traveling, Camping, Everyday Use, 8-Cup/33.8 Ounce, Black
features: DESIGNED TO LAST: Crafted from unbreakable BPA-free Tritan plastic with easy-pour spout and colorful frame and lid, this French press brews three 4-ounce espresso-sized cups of coffee
BREW TO YOUR TASTE: A patented shut-off infuser integrated into the stainless steel rod and silicone gasket plunger stops brewing process to lock in fresh-pressed flavor
CAPTURE IT ALL: Domed lid has built in filter to further reduce sediment in coffee and other hot beverages
EASY TO CLEAN: Plastic, BPA free French press is dishwasher safe for an easy cleanup
description: Create a coffee café experience, enjoying flavorful gourmet beverages brewed in the BonJour Coffee Unbreakable Plastic French Press. This stylish 33.8-ounce press brews eight 4-ounce espresso-sized cups of coffee and is crafted from crystal-clear, unbreakable BPA-free Tritan plastic. A patented shut-off infuser integrated right into the plunger of the French coffee press halts the brewing process to lock in fresh-pressed flavor. Additionally, an ingenious filtering lid helps reduce sediment in cups of coffee and espresso-based drinks. The plastic French press is dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.
